newsitem.title: UK: Vibroplant buys plant hire firm Torrent.
newsitem.headline: Vibroplant buys plant hire firm Torrent.

text.p: British plant hire company Vibroplant Plc said on Thursday that it has agreed to buy plant and tool hire firm Torrent for a maximum sum of 9.95 million stg.
Payment is based on six times Torrent's adjusted post-tax profit for the year to September 30, 1997.
Torrent primarily hires plant and tools to the rail industry and has 45 full time and six part time employees.
Vibroplant said that it was trading broadly in line with expectations after warning at the half year stage that its second half would be "considerably weaker" than the first due to seasonal factors.

The company said that it expects to pay a final dividend of 2.65p per share when it unveils annual results on June 4. If this is the case then the total dividend for the year would be maintained at 4.05p per share.
